fields.climate: desert; hot, dry summers with moderate winters
fields.terrain: vast desert plateau interrupted by Nile valley and delta
fields.hazards: periodic droughts; frequent earthquakes; flash floods; landslides; hot, driving windstorms called khamsin occur in spring; dust storms; sandstorms
fields.resources: petroleum, natural gas, iron ore, phosphates, manganese, limestone, gypsum, talc, asbestos, lead, rare earth elements, zinc
fields.farm: sugarcane, sugar beets, wheat, maize, potatoes, tomatoes, rice, milk, onions, oranges
fields.exports: refined petroleum, natural gas, fertilizers, garments, crude petroleum
fields.industries: textiles, food processing, tourism, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, hydrocarbons, construction, cement, metals, light manufactures
fields.languages: Arabic (official); English and French widely understood by educated classes
fields.religions: Muslim (predominantly Sunni) 90%, Christian (majority Coptic Orthodox, other Christians include Armenian Apostolic, Catholic, Maronite, Orthodox, and Anglican) 10%
fields.legal: mixed system based on Napoleonic civil and penal law, Islamic religious law, and vestiges of colonial-era laws; Supreme Constitutional Court reviews laws
fields.suffrage: 18 years of age; universal and compulsory
fields.military: voluntary enlistment possible from age 16 for men and 17 for women; 18-30 years of age for compulsory service for men; service obligation 14-36 months, followed by a 9-year reserve obligation…
